# design-skill

> One agent skill for designing any user-facing surface, material
> first: start from a kit that is already correct (tokens, browser
> surfaces, a real CJK webfont wired), roll a direction where a deck
> of born-designed worlds competes with the model's own candidates by
> subject affinity, write the chosen world into the artifact as a
> five-block promise, build, and let `kit/check.sh` fail what the
> craft references only used to advise. Observed palettes with
> provenance instead of seed-hue ramps; a zh mode one `lang`
> attribute flips; seven material contracts sharing one token schema.
> MIT.

One repo, one skill. The installed unit is `skills/design-skill/`;
everything above it is packaging. Install with `npx skills@latest add
lroolle/design-skill`, or as a Claude Code plugin (`/plugin
marketplace add lroolle/design-skill`), or by copying
`skills/design-skill/` into any agent's skill root. No build step;
`check.sh`, `fonts.sh` and `validate.sh` are bash + grep + curl,
`roll.mjs` is node with no dependencies.

## Entry

- [skills/design-skill/SKILL.md](skills/design-skill/SKILL.md): the
  protocol -- gate, modes, laws, four phases (sense, direct, build,
  review), the check, the map

## The kit (the product)

- [kit/README.md](skills/design-skill/kit/README.md): which kit when; the zh switch; wiring by stack; governed systems; what check.sh enforces
- [kit/bases/](skills/design-skill/kit/bases/README.md): eight renderable standing exits -- behavior and states to keep, topology for the roll to replace
- [kit/floor/](skills/design-skill/kit/floor/tokens.css): correct without a look -- tokens, [base.css](skills/design-skill/kit/floor/base.css) (browser surfaces, focus, the `:lang(zh)` block), [fonts.zh.css](skills/design-skill/kit/floor/fonts.zh.css), [fonts.latin.css](skills/design-skill/kit/floor/fonts.latin.css)
- [kit/house/](skills/design-skill/kit/house/tokens.css): our aesthetic -- ink on paper, administrative register, CJK-native, rules not boxes; [base.css](skills/design-skill/kit/house/base.css), [components.css](skills/design-skill/kit/house/components.css)
- [kit/check.sh](skills/design-skill/kit/check.sh): FAIL / WARN tiers over source; raw color, palette classes, saturated faces, fake content, the promise and roll key, zh without a CJK webfont, leading, measure, the computed ramp, the floor shipped unchanged, the generated-dashboard shape
- [kit/render-check.mjs](skills/design-skill/kit/render-check.mjs): same tiers over the rendered page (playwright) -- overflow at 390, contrast in both schemes read from painted pixels, tap targets, focus visibility, reduced-motion settling, evidence width, dark authored
- [kit/fonts.sh](skills/design-skill/kit/fonts.sh): self-host any face as unicode-range slices (Google Fonts split, or `--slice` a vendor ttf)

## Specimens (observed, with provenance)

- [specimens/palettes/](skills/design-skill/specimens/palettes/README.md): ten observed palettes -- timetable paper, almanac leaf, stone rubbing, nautical chart, patent sheet, Du Bois plates, isotype, split-flap, thread-bound book, teletext -- each with its irregularity and the reflex it must not become
- [specimens/type/](skills/design-skill/specimens/type/README.md): real settings at real sizes -- zh body, zh display, Latin body, the data table
- [specimens/zh-voice.md](skills/design-skill/specimens/zh-voice.md): Chinese copy register -- the failure dissected, the rules, good and bad side by side

## Decks and dice

- [decks/worlds/](skills/design-skill/decks/worlds/_template.md): 27 born-designed graphic systems (a third CJK), affinity-tagged so they can enter the roll; one card per `<id>.md`
- [decks/compositions/](skills/design-skill/decks/compositions/_template.md): 14 compositions for surface-scope rolls
- [decks/recipes/](skills/design-skill/decks/recipes/_template.md): 8 surface contracts, each linked to a working base
- [scripts/roll.mjs](skills/design-skill/scripts/roll.mjs): `node scripts/roll.mjs --scope direction|surface --mode <mode> --subject "<brief>" [--zh] [--grain] [--key] [--reroll n] [--list] [--json]`

## Systems (tokens plus component geometry; swap the css file)

- [systems/README.md](skills/design-skill/systems/README.md): token and component-geometry contract, base proof, invariants
- [default](skills/design-skill/systems/default.md) · [modernist](skills/design-skill/systems/modernist.md) · [classical](skills/design-skill/systems/classical.md) · [industry](skills/design-skill/systems/industry.md) · [organic](skills/design-skill/systems/organic.md) · [nocturnes](skills/design-skill/systems/nocturnes.md) · [broadsheets](skills/design-skill/systems/broadsheets.md) -- compact proof card beside `systems/<name>.css`

## References (the why)

- [thinking](skills/design-skill/references/thinking.md) · [craft](skills/design-skill/references/craft.md) (type, structure, motion) · [cjk](skills/design-skill/references/cjk.md) · [color](skills/design-skill/references/color.md) · [simulation](skills/design-skill/references/simulation.md) · [anti-patterns](skills/design-skill/references/anti-patterns.md) · [priors](skills/design-skill/references/priors.md) (rejections observed across our builds; a project's TASTE.md starts empty) · [platforms](skills/design-skill/references/platforms.md)
- [assets/primitives/](skills/design-skill/assets/primitives/README.md): working behavior models in six layers (point-cloud)

## The skill used on itself

- [site/README.md](site/README.md): the page at lroolle.com/design-skill -- static, no build step
- [site/DESIGN.md](site/DESIGN.md): the material contract written at finish
- [site/index.html](site/index.html): the promise is the first comment in the body
- [site/deal.js](site/deal.js): the deal, running in the browser over [site/deck.js](site/deck.js) (generated by [site/deck.mjs](site/deck.mjs)); [site/deal-check.mjs](site/deal-check.mjs) proves it equals the CLI

## Packaging and proof

- [.claude-plugin/plugin.json](.claude-plugin/plugin.json) · [.claude-plugin/marketplace.json](.claude-plugin/marketplace.json)
- [assets/DESIGN.md.tmpl](skills/design-skill/assets/DESIGN.md.tmpl) · [assets/TASTE.md.tmpl](skills/design-skill/assets/TASTE.md.tmpl) · [scripts/validate.sh](scripts/validate.sh)
- [evals/README.md](evals/README.md): the loop that makes rules earn their place -- frozen scenarios with frozen roll keys, baselines, first attempts, corrections routed to the narrowest enforcing layer; [evals/LEDGER.md](evals/LEDGER.md) records which run earned which rule; [evals/scenarios/01-ds-site.md](evals/scenarios/01-ds-site.md) is the live one
